title: lithospermum rosei
intro: Lithospermum rosei, commonly known as Gromwell, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). Traditionally, Gromwell has been used in herbal medicine to support health and well-being, offering benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Gromwell include its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lithospermum rosei include caffeic acid, lithospermic acid, and other flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
